title: gagea iberica var. lacaitae
intro: Gagea iberica var. lacaitae, commonly known as the Spanish gagea, is a perennial plant species belonging to the lily family (Liliaceae). The Spanish gagea is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in the Spanish gagea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
